sloka: न मत् विधो दुष्कृत कर्म कारीमन्ये द्वितीयो अस्ति वसुंधरायाम् ।शोक अनुशोको हि परंपरायामाम् एति भिन्दन् हृदयम् मनः च ॥३-६३-३॥
transliteration: na mat vidho duṣkṛta karma kārīmanye dvitīyo asti vasuṁdharāyām ।śoka anuśoko hi paraṁparāyāmām eti bhindan hṛdayam manaḥ ca ॥3-63-3॥

translations.english: I think there is none on earth like me who has performed such forbidden acts. One grief after the other is successively piercing my heart and my mind.
